create_ShardWriter: create a ShardWriter instance from a rounder to handle shard-saving of model parameters
test_save_module: test saving a torch module's tensors into the ShardWriter with a given prefix name
test_finalize: test finalizing the ShardWriter to flush remaining tensors and write shard files to disk
test_tie_word_embeddings_missing: test that ShardWriter saves the tail layer when tie_word_embeddings is absent from config
test_tie_word_embeddings_true: test that ShardWriter skips the lm_head and offloads to meta when tie_word_embeddings is true
